title: Forward Scan Step
statement: Let $W$ and $M$ be finite Turing machines over Boolean symbols, let $a$ be a natural number, and let $x$ be a schedule-alphabet input. Suppose the base guide tape equals the guide of radius $R$ and the guide head is at $g\ne R+1$. From the forward phase, one simulator step advances the guide head to $g+1$ and replaces each neighbor register by the current payload decoded at coordinate $g$. It updates each data tape only at $g$, writing a data cell whose current payload is the decoded current payload there and whose cached left-neighbor payload is the old neighbor register; the state, answer bit, saved reads, and output are unchanged.
